notes: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (dense: 48 Gated DeltaNet + 16 gated-attention layers, 27B parameters) as unsloth's Q8_0 GGUF (27.05 GiB, all weights in VRAM, tensor parallel over the two V100s (engine_args --tp 1), bnk's dense engine: src/dense, docs/DENSE.md). Q8_0 is the near-lossless quant that fits both cards with room for the context: the engine's per-layer output matches llama.cpp's fp32 CPU path within ~1% (quantized activations), top token identical on every prompt tested. The drafter is the model's own MTP block (mtp: builtin, in the same file: block 64); the draft head runs over run.sh's draft vocabulary. Sampling as the Qwen release recommends. Context 262,144 (the model's native length) with the KV cache in 8 bits (--kv8 1: 32 KiB per token instead of 64, so two full-length conversations fit beside the weights; KL vs the fp16 cache 1e-3) and two slots; the KV cache is mapped as a conversation grows, so short conversations cost nothing.
